svg.title: How the disco ball is built
svg.desc: Three steps. A flat grid of squares. Each square gets two angles, one for how far around the ball and one for how far from top to bottom, and sine and cosine turn them into a point on a sphere. The result is a ball of squares, where each row of the grid becomes one ring.
svg.text: Sine and cosine do the wrapping
x = r · sin θ · cos φ
y = r · sin θ · sin φ
